title: Logging In
content: To log in, enter your username and password...

title: Creating a Contact
content: Go to Contacts > New and fill out the form...

title: Adding a Product
content: Navigate to Inventory > Add Product and fill in the fields...

title: Removing a Product
content: Select the product and click Remove...

title: Resetting Password
content: Click 'Forgot Password' and follow the instructions...
